question.worked_solution:
We need to isolate all terms with $m$ on one side of the equation. To do this, we first cross-multiply:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{7mn+2n}{4} & =\frac{3m}{7} \\ 7\cdot (7mn+2n) & =4\cdot 3m \\ 49mn+14n & =12m\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we subtract $49mn$ from both sides of the equation:

$$
\begin{aligned}49mn+14n & =12m \\ 49mn+14n-49mn & =12m-49mn \\ 14n & =12m-49mn\end{aligned}
$$

Notice that all terms containing $m$ are on the right-hand side, and all terms independent of $m$ are on the left-hand side.

Then, we factor out $m$ from the right-hand side:

$$
\begin{aligned}14n & =12m-49mn \\ 14n & =(12-49n)m\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we divide both sides by $(12-49n)$ to isolate $m:$

$$
\begin{aligned}14n & =(12-49n)m \\ \frac{14n}{12-49n} & =\frac{\cancel{(12-49n)}m}{\cancel{12-49n}} \\ \frac{14n}{12-49n} & =m \\ m & =\frac{14n}{12-49n}\end{aligned}
$$

**Note:** This result assumes that $12-49n\ne 0.$
